faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Union City?
faq.answer: Union City homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This East Bay community's 1960s–1980s housing stock features standard sizing that makes replacement efficient and cost-effective. Single window installation starts at approximately $440.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Union City?
faq.answer: Yes. Union City requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Union City Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Union City?
faq.answer: For Union City's East Bay suburban market, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for cost-effective whole-home replacements, Simonton for budget-conscious full-home projects, and Anlin Del Mar for homeowners looking to upgrade to triple-pane energy performance.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Union City neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Union City neighborhoods including Alvarado, Decoto, and Masonic Village. Zip code: 94587.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Union City?
faq.answer: Most Union City projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
